label: Schlözer 1772 places colouring of Facta outside legitimate historical criticism and arrangement
subject: work.schlozer-vorstellung-universalhistorie.1772
object: Facta altered or rhetorically coloured by historian

sources.citation: August Ludwig von Schlözer, Vorstellung seiner Universal-Historie, part 1 (Göttingen/Gotha: Dieterich, 1772), pp. 44-45; ULB Sachsen-Anhalt Na 1135 d

observations.value: Zusammenstellung is assigned to the historian; its special manner constitutes Universalhistorie as method

claim_limit: Do not infer that Schlözer rejected pictorial, tabular or chromatic aids in general. The criticism targets intervention at the Facta layer.

label: Schlözer 1775 licenses illumination and painted display at the relation/duration/memory layer
subject: work.schlozer-vorstellung-universalhistorie.1775

sources.citation: August Ludwig von Schlözer, Vorstellung der Universal-Historie, 2nd revised ed. (Göttingen: Dieterich, 1775), ULB Sachsen-Anhalt AB 22 A 9/k, 26 (1)
Modern study quoting Schlözer 1775 on gemahlte chronologische Tabellen, Synchronismus by Association der Ideen, and Illumination der Tabelle

observations.value: Illumination is proposed to make the unequal length and duration of principal world-historical periods visible to the young eye; painted co-presence supports memory of synchronism.

claim_limit: Exact 1775 page wording remains secondary-quotation control until the institutional scan page is directly inspected. Do not mark primary_direct yet.

label: Actor-level colour jurisdiction in Schlözer: facts versus historical arrangement/display

observations.value: The same author rejects colouring Facta in 1772 while in 1775 recommending or entertaining illumination/painted display for period duration and synchronism. The legitimacy of chromatic intervention is therefore layer-specific rather than governed by a general pro-/anti-colour stance.
Colour can now be treated as an actor-grounded test of epistemic jurisdiction: what operation colour is allowed to perform, at which point in historical knowledge production, and under what warrant.

claim_limit: This does not establish that the 1773 Gatterer-Schlözer polemic explicitly debated colour. It strengthens colour as an actor-level discriminator inside the broader dispute over historical arrangement, media and method.

label: Directly close Schlözer's fact-versus-table colour jurisdiction
notes: 1772 directly establishes the negative fact-layer boundary; 1775 scholarly quotation supplies the positive table/display side. The decisive remaining task is primary page-image control of the 1775 wording and comparison with the revised 1775 formulation of the 1772 method sequence.
reopen_rule: Inspect the ULB Sachsen-Anhalt 1775 digitization around the quoted discussion of gemahlte chronologische Tabellen and Illumination der Tabelle; record page/image locator and diplomatic wording. Then compare the 1772 and 1775 editions for continuity or revision of Kritik/Facta/Zusammenstellung language.

label: Gatterer human colour classification from Universalhistorie to Menschen- und Völkerkunde, 1771–1778
notes: A modern scholarly source cites Gatterer's 1771 Einleitung in die synchronistische Universalhistorie for bodily markers Statur, Gestalt and [Haut]Farbe used in human typification, indicating that the classifier regime begins before the 1775 Abriß der Geographie. The later Menschen- und Völkerkunde should be treated as a possible formalization rather than an assumed point of origin.
reopen_rule: Inspect Gatterer 1771 BSB/MDZ carrier bsb10716342 and the 1775/1778 geography editions. Record the exact headings and sentences for Statur/Gestalt/Farbe, what is being classified, and whether the operation is descriptive, comparative, geographic, causal or taxonomic. Do not project later racial categories backward.
